title: Living Together in Uttarakhand? UCC Says Register It
desc: Under Uttarakhand's Uniform Civil Code, live-in partners must file a statement with the Registrar within one month, or face fines and possible jail.
why: Uttarakhand is still the only state that requires live-in couples to register with the government, and people in Haldwani and Nainital keep asking what the Uniform Civil Code actually requires of them.
keyPoints: Live-in partners anywhere in Uttarakhand must submit a statement to the local Registrar within one month of starting to live together.
Not registering can bring up to three months in jail, a fine of up to Rs 10,000, or both.
Giving false information in the statement can bring a fine of up to Rs 25,000.
A child born to a registered live-in couple is treated as legitimate under the law.

sections.h: What does the UCC require for a live-in relationship?
p: Under the Uttarakhand Uniform Civil Code Act, 2024, in force since 27 January 2025, partners in a live-in relationship anywhere in the state must submit a statement to the local Registrar within one month of starting to live together. This applies to Uttarakhand residents even if they live together outside the state, and to anyone living together within Uttarakhand regardless of where they are from.

The requirement does not apply to members of Scheduled Tribes, whose customary rights are separately protected under the Constitution. If either partner is under 21, the Registrar must inform their parents or guardian once the statement is received.

sections.h: What happens if you don't register?
p: Staying in an unregistered live-in relationship for more than one month can bring imprisonment of up to three months, a fine of up to Rs 10,000, or both. Giving false details in the statement carries a separate, higher fine of up to Rs 25,000.
The law also states that a child born to a live-in couple is legitimate, so missing the registration deadline does not take away the child's legal status or inheritance rights.

whatToDo: If you start living with a partner in Uttarakhand, submit the statement to the local Registrar within one month.
Keep a copy of the statement and any acknowledgment or certificate you receive.
If either partner is under 21, expect the Registrar to inform parents or guardians after registration.
Check the official portal at ucc.uk.gov.in for the current registration process and documents needed.

hi.title: उत्तराखंड में लिव-इन में रह रहे हैं? UCC में रजिस्ट्रेशन जरूरी
keyPoints: उत्तराखंड में लिव-इन में रहने वाले जोड़ों को साथ रहना शुरू करने के एक महीने के भीतर स्थानीय रजिस्ट्रार के पास स्टेटमेंट देना जरूरी है।
रजिस्ट्रेशन न कराने पर तीन महीने तक की जेल, 10,000 रुपये तक जुर्माना, या दोनों हो सकते हैं।
गलत जानकारी देने पर 25,000 रुपये तक जुर्माना हो सकता है।
रजिस्टर्ड लिव-इन जोड़े से पैदा बच्चे को कानूनी रूप से वैध माना जाता है।
p: उत्तराखंड यूनिफॉर्म सिविल कोड के तहत लिव-इन में रहने वाले जोड़ों को रजिस्ट्रार के पास जानकारी देनी होती है, चाहे वे उत्तराखंड के निवासी हों या बाहर से आकर यहां रह रहे हों।

sources.title: Uttarakhand Uniform Civil Code Act, 2024 (Act No. 3 of 2024)
